drhp.business: Diamines & Chemicals Limited manufactures Ethylene Amines at its plant in PCC Area, Vadodara, serving industry segments including Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients & Pharma-Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals, Agro-chemicals, Resins, Water treatment chemicals, Petroleum production chemicals and Additives. The company reports two primary segments: Specialty Chemicals (Ethylene Amines manufacturing) and trading in Fruits and Vegetables. It is supported by an in-house R&D centre and quality assurance department.

drhp.expansion: No specific named capex project with a commissioning or completion timeline is disclosed in this bundle. The Company operates a captive Wind Turbine Generator (WTG) facility of total 0.75 MW capacity at Shikharpur, Kutch, Gujarat, used for captive consumption to reduce carbon footprint. The Company has planned a Hazard and Operability Analysis (HAZOP) for new installations and current operations to improve process safety, and continues energy-conservation measures including a planned increase in throughput alongside yield improvements.
